channel.title: Sidhu's Views
channel.description: A curated personal online magazine exploring lifestyle, style, crafting, storytelling, and digital experiments by Gurdeep Sidhu.

item.title: How to Crochet an Easy Square Coaster: Beginner Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: Make an aesthetic 4x4 inch cotton square coaster in under 45 minutes. Professional step-by-step pattern with exact stitch counts, US terminology, step photos, and wet blocking tips by Gurdeep Sidhu.

item.title: The Beginner's Guide to Cozy Crochet: Stitches, Hooks & Easy Projects
item.description: Everything you need to start crocheting today. Learn essential stitches, how to choose hooks and yarn, and 3 beginner-friendly project ideas.

item.title: Aesthetic Room Decor on a Budget: Transforming Spaces for Under ₹5,000
item.description: Practical, stylish room decor ideas that fit real Indian homes. How to use warm lighting, indoor plants, texture, and DIY wall art without breaking the bank.

item.title: The Slow Morning Ritual: How 30 Intentional Minutes Can Transform Your Day
item.description: Why rushing into your morning ruins focus, and how a simple 3-step quiet morning routine builds mental clarity and creativity.

item.title: Creating a Cozy Reading Nook: Designing Your Home Sanctuary
item.description: How to turn an unused corner into a peaceful reading nook with soft armchair lighting, throw blankets, and side tables.

item.title: Whispers of Sainj Valley: A Hidden Paradise in Himachal
item.description: Escape the tourist crowds in Shangarh and Sainj Valley. Green meadows, ancient wooden temples, and quiet Himalayan homestays.
